reason: Known gap, not a parity claim. These pages style their buttons with an @font-face web font. turbo-surf's static path loads no @font-face, so the button text uses a fallback font and cannot match Chrome. The 0.7.0 line-height changes (#178, #245, #246) move the button 8 px in that fallback font: Chrome 156 y52 h21, surf 0.6.0 y50 h28, surf 0.7.0 y44 h26. 0.7.0 is not closer to Chrome here. These outputs stay a known gap until surf's static path loads web fonts.
